title: A partly failed bulk activation names the failed part, and a retry changes nothing
custom_preconds: Admin. Inactive parts A and B. Two browser tabs on Inventory.
custom_steps:
1. Tab 1: Inactive tab → Activate parts → tick A and B → Activate (leave the confirmation open)
  2. Tab 2: open A → Part Status Active → Save → confirm
  3. Tab 1: confirm the activation
  4. Click Activate again with only A ticked → confirm
custom_expected:
1. Confirmation shows 2 parts selected
  2. A is active
  3. Toast "1 part updated, 1 could not be changed." with "{A number}: Part is already in that state."; B leaves the list; only A stays ticked
  4. "No parts were changed."; nothing else changes
